conventions.one_MAC: one dot-product multiply-accumulate;2FLOPs by common convention;bias adds excluded
conventions.included: Every executed Conv2d/Linear including recurrent repeated calls and aux/readouts (including unused off transport head)
conventions.excluded: attention tensor products,normalization,activation,interpolation,elementwise operations,loss/TV and all physical-stencil/exponential arithmetic; data transfer/allocator/runtime not FLOPs
conventions.scope: partial module MAC accounting, NOT full inference FLOPs or paper13.1G reproduction. Dynamic numerical work separately counted for fixed first heldout example; does not imply faster runtime.
